# Wonderfall

> Animated desktop effects for Mac by Andrii (Andrew) Sereda. The Mac App Store app ID is 6755106853. Wonderfall was formerly named SnowMyScreen; both names refer to the same app.

## Wonderfall for Mac
- Requires macOS 14.6 or later; Mac only.
- Seasonal effects: falling snow, rain, autumn leaves, spring petals and summer fireflies.
- Custom images (common formats and SVG) can move like snow, leaves or rain. Import up to 10 at once; the app prepares the size automatically.
- Version 1.3 (November 2026) is the current App Store release. Snow settles on top of open windows, the snow bank can be rolled into snowballs and a snowman, and a snowplow clears it. Decorative lights with eight scenes hang along the menu bar, the Dock or both. Interactive tools clear snow, leaves, petals and raindrops.
- Place the overlay over open windows or on the desktop behind them, while keeping the existing wallpaper.
- Controls include intensity, size, speed and wind. Snow can pile up at the bottom of the screen and be cleared with a shovel.
- Optional weather matching uses location permission and Apple WeatherKit.
- Rain is a visual effect without ambient rain audio.
- US store price checked on 2026-11-10: US$1.99. Prices depend on the region and may change; the App Store is the source of pricing.
- The app is a desktop overlay, not a replacement for wallpaper or the macOS screensaver.

- [Product overview](https://getwonderfall.com/): Effects, review excerpts, setup steps and frequently asked questions.
- [Setup and support](https://getwonderfall.com/support/): Menu bar controls, image import and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy](https://getwonderfall.com/privacy.html): Local app storage, optional location and WeatherKit, and separate consent for website analytics.
- [Press kit](https://getwonderfall.com/press/): Fact sheet, the story behind the app, a developer quote, the icon, screenshots and screen recordings.
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755106853): Download and local pricing.
- [Original App Store reviews](https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/snowmyscreen/id6755106853?see-all=reviews&platform=mac): Ukrainian storefront; reviews were written for SnowMyScreen.

## Guides
- [Mac desktop guides](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/)
- [How to Give Your Mac a Christmas Theme: Wallpaper, Snow and Lights](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/christmas-theme-mac/): Turn your Mac or MacBook desktop into a Christmas scene: a festive wallpaper, falling snow, menu bar lights, a snow drift and a New Year variation.
- [SnowMyScreen Is Now Wonderfall: What’s New in Version 1.2](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/snowmyscreen-is-now-wonderfall/): SnowMyScreen is now Wonderfall. Version 1.2 adds snow drifts and a shovel, Christmas lights with eight scenes, rain, leaves, petals and weather matching.
- [How to Put Christmas Lights on Your Mac Desktop](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/christmas-lights-mac-desktop/): Hang animated Christmas lights along your Mac menu bar, pick a scene, colors and glow, and keep them over your windows or only on the desktop.
- [How to Build a Snowman on Your Mac Desktop](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/snowman-mac-desktop/): Let snow pile up at the bottom of your Mac screen, roll snowballs, stack a snowman, throw snowballs at your windows and call a snowplow to clean up.
- [Wonderfall 1.3: Snow on Your Windows, Snowballs and a Snowplow](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/wonderfall-1-3-snow-on-windows/): Wonderfall 1.3 lets snow settle on top of your Mac windows and move with them, adds snowballs, a snowman, a snowplow and a leaf sweeper.
- [Animated Snow on Your Mac: Wallpaper, Screensaver or Overlay?](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/animated-snow-mac-desktop/): Moving wallpaper, snow screensaver or desktop overlay: what each option does on a Mac and how to keep snow falling over your own wallpaper while you work.
- [How to Add Snow to Your Mac Desktop (and Other Seasonal Effects)](https://getwonderfall.com/blog/mac-desktop-effects/): Set up falling snow on your Mac, customize the motion and your own images, and explore Wonderfall’s seasonal effects without changing your wallpaper.

- [Як повісити новорічну гірлянду на робочий стіл Mac](https://getwonderfall.com/uk/blog/christmas-lights-mac-desktop/): Повісьте анімовану гірлянду вздовж рядка меню Mac, оберіть сцену, кольори й сяйво та покажіть її поверх вікон або лише на робочому столі.

- [Wonderfall 1.3: сніг на вікнах, сніжки й снігоочисник](https://getwonderfall.com/uk/blog/wonderfall-1-3-snow-on-windows/): У Wonderfall 1.3 сніг лягає на верхні краї вікон Mac і рухається з ними, а ще з’явилися сніжки, сніговик, снігоочисник і машинка для листя.
- [Анімований сніг на Mac: шпалери, скринсейвер чи оверлей?](https://getwonderfall.com/uk/blog/animated-snow-mac-desktop/): Рухомі шпалери, скринсейвер зі снігом чи оверлей: що робить кожен варіант на Mac і як залишити сніг поверх своїх шпалер під час роботи.
- [Як додати сніг на робочий стіл Mac та інші сезонні ефекти](https://getwonderfall.com/uk/blog/mac-desktop-effects/): Увімкніть сніг на робочому столі Mac, налаштуйте анімацію й власні зображення та спробуйте сезонні ефекти Wonderfall, зберігши свої шпалери.
